description: Ergotron LX monitor arm manual, pages placed on desk one at a time. GT curated 2026-06-11 by dense filmstrip review (3fps) + accepted-crop comparison.

pages.label: Install steps 2-3 page (0deg box, M4 screws) with warning text bottom half
Step 5 tilt page (First time may take more force, monitor tilt diagrams)
pages.notes: Missed by yolo2 run: sharp but illustration-sparse, Tenengrad median 16 < gate 30

pages.label: Step 7 Adjustment Step page, multilingual dense text body
Circle detail diagram page (cable routing closeup, arm sketches top right)
Yup that's it Really page (person standing at desk illustration)
pages.notes: Missed by yolo2 run: sharp, conf 0.73, but Tenengrad median 11 < gate 30

pages.label: Multilingual safety page (Seguridad/Securite header, dark WARNING figure top left)
Ergotron logo page (mostly blank, small car/arm sketch bottom)
Nearly blank page with single faint heading line
pages.notes: Almost no texture; excluded from recall denominator. Matching it is OK, missing it is OK.

pages.label: Safety page with weight capacity arm diagram (3-25 lbs)
pages.notes: Do NOT widen below 30.2: a distinct brief face (g13) occupies 29.2-30.1

pages.label: Safety page with angle diagrams (13/70/360/180 deg, page 13 of 17)
Step 10 Adjustment Step page (monitor rear + arm, allen key icons)
pages.notes: Missed by yolo2 run: sharp, conf 0.77, Tenengrad median 18 < gate 30

pages.label: Increase/Decrease Friction page (kg icon, boxed multilingual text, Securite header)
pages.notes: On screen only ~1 s between the blank back (g08) and g09. Missed by every pre-rescue run AND by the original GT curation; discovered by the rescue pass (idx 294), verified against raw frames t=29.4-29.8.

pages.label: Step 8 Adjustment Step page (tool/shaft diagrams)
pages.notes: Shown only ~1.5s at video end; missed by yolo2 run (blur gate)

nonPages: Blank white page backs during turns (t~22-24s)
notes: 12 real pages + 1 optional near-blank (g08). g13 (visible ~1 s) was discovered by the rescue pass on 2026-06-12 — even the original GT curation missed it. yolo2 winners covered only 7 faces; count-based recall 1.0 was inflated by duplicates.
